children.game_version: Run the weaving line game where children high-five alternating side partners down the track.

seniors.counts: Use 8 counts per spin instead of 16 to reduce dizziness.
seniors.seated_version: Perform alternating right and left arm links with seated side partners at reduced tempo.
seniors.standing_version: Walk the line turns at half tempo using gentle forearm touches instead of fast elbow spins.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to 80-90 BPM and limit spin rotation speed.

learning_units.description: Mastering the alternating arm-link turn progression down a longways set.

social_formats.description: Longways set with couples progressing from top to bottom through arm turns.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Linked elbows (left arm to outside line, right arm to partner)
movement_profile.footwork: Skip-change step or relaxed rhythmic walking turn step
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Longways set facing partner across a parallel aisle
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso rotates smoothly to absorb momentum of continuous turning
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Ground-level traveling turns without high leaps
movement_profile.partnering: Alternating forearm or linked elbow turns with partner and line members
movement_profile.posture: Upright, active social dance stance with flexible knees and firm elbow connections

signature_moves.description: Alternating left-elbow turn with line dancer and right-elbow turn with partner progressing down the line
signature_moves.name: The Willow Strip

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Pulling forcefully on partner arms or losing count of arm alternations

music_profile.musical_form: AABB repeating structure adjusted to set length
music_profile.sound_description: Energetic, driving accordion and fiddle jigs playing continuous compound-meter melodies like 'Drops of Brandy'.
music_profile.vocal_style: Instrumental dance music, occasionally accompanied by caller prompts or vocal shouts

basic_steps: Top couple link right arms and spin in the center for 16 beats.
Lady turns line dancer anti-clockwise with left arm, then partner clockwise with right arm.
Gentleman turns line dancer anti-clockwise with left arm, then partner clockwise with right arm.
Both partners simultaneously turn line dancers anti-clockwise and each other clockwise down the set.
teaching.formation: Longways set (line of gentlemen facing line of ladies)
teaching.level_notes: Accessible to beginners; requires stamina for continuous turning.
